headline: End of fake experts — Kyrgyzstan takes on online coaches
summary: Kyrgyzstan proposes requiring bloggers, coaches and business trainers who sell online consultations and courses to disclose their qualifications. The proposal was reported by 24.kg.
why: Regulation of online professional services affects the growing digital education and consulting market and consumer protection rules.
original_headline: Конец фальшивым экспертам — в Кыргызстане взялись за онлайн-коучей
